title: Zohran Mamdani sworn in as New York City mayor
summary: Zohran Mamdani has officially taken office as New York City’s mayor after a surprise victory last year in which the 34-year-old Democratic Socialist defeated former governor Andrew Cuomo, making history as the first Muslim and first Asian American to lead the nation’s largest city.
